Keep lies specific but unverifiable—e.g., "Sources close to the matter confirm..." Avoid outright provable fabrications to evade quick debunking. Test on a small focus group via anonymous surveys to ensure they stick.

Track metrics: Sentiment analysis via Mention.com (aim for 30% negative shift). If polls show reputational damage (e.g., via YouGov), declare "mission accomplished." Fade out by deleting accounts. Reproducibility tip: Scale with budget—$5k for small target, $50k for national figure.
